obligation_model.two_layer: Task state records lifecycle. Every waiting or blocking reason is a separately persisted obligation row; the state label is derived from the open obligations and never overwrites them.
obligation_model.multiplicity: A task may hold several obligations at once. Resolving one never clears another.
obligation_model.derivation: BLOCKED while any blocker obligation is open; otherwise WAITING while any waiting obligation is open; otherwise the lifecycle state stands.
obligation_model.append_only: Opening and resolving an obligation are append-only events. A resolved obligation is never deleted.

caller_contract.rule: A caller submits an event and may assert what it believes to be true. The target state is resolved from persisted facts. An assertion that contradicts persisted facts is refused, not obeyed.

refusals_are_recorded: Every refused transition is written to the append-only history with its event, its source state and its refusal reason.
no_wildcards: There is no wildcard, catch-all or default transition. Every (state, event) pair below carries an explicit ALLOWED or REFUSED decision.
success_preconditions: No obligation of any kind is open.
No blocking review finding on the current tuple is unresolved.
CI is recorded as passed for the exact current (repository, base, head) tuple, from the recomputed current evidence snapshot.
The acting principal holds a valid, unexpired lease for the task.
No effect-journal entry for this task is in UNKNOWN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION.
No effect-journal entry for this task is ABANDONED_BY_DECISION.
abandonment_rules: ABANDONED_BY_DECISION never releases a task from any obligation.
ABANDONED_BY_DECISION never satisfies a dependency for another task.
ABANDONED_BY_DECISION never satisfies the Phase 0 completion gate condition G0-8.
redo_rule: A terminal task is never revived. Repeating the work means creating a new task or a new attempt, with its own identity and its own history.
